project.name: ALTEN AI Copilot :: backend
project.description:
Aggregator for the backend microservices. This is a pure aggregator: each module keeps spring-boot-starter-parent as its own parent, so building a module on its own (cd auth-service && ./mvnw ...) still works exactly as before. This pom only lets you build or test all five at once:
./mvnw -f backend install -DskipTests ./mvnw -f backend test ./mvnw -f backend -pl auth-service spring-boot:run
